coordination_holds_append: The b31 table and symmetric 5+5+2 chair group are centred at X=26.25 m, Y=14.41 m in the 10.50 × 6.82 m Side B dining territory, not merely aligned to an edge or door.

The 3.20 × 1.10 m table is an evidence-based coordination envelope, not a selected product. Leg/pedestal positions, apron, chair width, armrests and actual manufacturer seating capacity govern procurement.

The 1.10 m clearance envelope follows the upper end of the researched 36–44 in chair/passage guidance. The larger available residual margins remain shared open-space buffers, not required furniture clearances.
Centre any linear pendant or pendant group on the final table, not on the larger dining territory; coordinate circuit and support only after the table position is adopted.
This refinement supersedes b30 only as the latest option study. PB b29 and D-071 remain active until the opposite-side dining move is explicitly adopted.
